content_sections.heading: About CSL
content_sections.text: Cochin Shipyard Limited is a listed Miniratna Schedule 'A' company of the Government of India, based in Kochi. This notice is issued by its General Manager (HR & LD) for engaging General Workers in the employees' canteen on contract.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post, General Worker (Canteen) on contract basis, with 13 vacancies. The break-up is below. CSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, not to fill any of them, or to cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement. Essential: Pass in VII Std. The minimum qualification must be from a University, Institute or Examination Board recognised by AICTE or the appropriate statutory authority, or State or Central Government. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority; without it, the candidature is not considered. Desirable: One year Certificate Course in Food Production / Food and Beverages Service from a Government Food Craft Institute, or two year Vocational Certificate in Catering and Restaurant Management from an institution recognised by Central/State Government. Knowledge of Malayalam. Experience in preparation or serving of meals. The upper age limit shall not exceed 30 years as on 24 November 2026, that is, applicants should be born on or after 25 November 1996. The notice prints no minimum age. The monthly consolidated pay during the first year of contract is ₹20,200 per month, and an annual increase applies in the subsequent years. Selected candidates are also eligible for extra hours of work beyond normal work hours. The contract tenure is five years, depending on organizational requirement and individual performance. Applicants in the final year of a contract on CSL rolls as on the date of the notice may apply, subject to meeting all other requirements. Applicants in the first, second, third or fourth year of their contract with CSL as on that date are not eligible to apply for the same post. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: CSL General Worker (Canteen) Job Description
content_sections.text: Preparation and supply of food items, cleaning of utensils, furniture, buildings, etc., and other similar works in the employees' canteen at CSL. Work on board vessels during sea trials, and any other duties assigned by the reporting officer or supervisors concerned. Climbing ladders to serve tea and snacks on board vessels under construction or repair and docks, and movement through confined areas. Work in multiple shifts, including night hours beyond 7 pm.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application form in Annexure I with a recent passport size photograph pasted on it. A photo-identity proof (original). Aadhaar card: original and self-attested copy. Original certificates and testimonials in proof of age/date of birth, educational qualification, caste etc., with self-attested copies. Ex-servicemen: Discharge Certificate / Book / Pension Payment Order from the Armed Forces. EWS applicants: a valid Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format, issued by the authorities named in the notice. SC, ST or OBC (Non Creamy Layer) applicants: a valid recent community certificate issued by a Revenue Authority not below the rank of Tahsildar. Annexure I, the application format, is on the CSL website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page, CSL, Kochi). The application must be complete in all respects and signed. Incomplete or unsigned applications, and those that are not in the prescribed format, not legible or without the required enclosures, are rejected without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Applicants submit their applications in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of certificates at the venue. Applications submitted in any other mode are not accepted, and an application once submitted is final. Depending on the number of applications received, CSL reserves the right to scrutinise them and shortlist candidates on the copies of certificates, and only shortlisted candidates may be permitted to attend the selection process. Applications are verified against the original certificates. Only candidates who complete the certificate verification are allowed to attend the Practical Test, on subsequent dates that will be communicated separately to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail or the CSL website. Candidates who cannot produce the original certificates are rejected. Selection is through a Practical Test out of 100 marks. The minimum pass mark is 50% of total marks for unreserved posts and EWS candidates, 45% for OBC candidates (only for vacancies reserved for OBC), and 40% for SC/ST candidates (only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST). CSL may relax the minimum pass mark if the number of qualified candidates is insufficient. Rank lists are prepared on marks secured by candidates who meet the eligibility requirements and pass the Practical Test. If marks are equal, relative merit is decided by seniority in age. The rank list is valid up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate advised to join, or until a fresh notification for the same post is issued. Shortlisted candidates must also undergo a medical examination in hospitals prescribed by CSL, and appointment is subject to medical fitness.

faq.question: Q1. What is the CSL General Worker (Canteen) walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection is on 24 November 2026, when applications are received through the walk-in.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Applications are received from 0830 Hrs to 1200 Hrs and 1300 Hrs to 1430 Hrs at Cochin Shipyard Recreation Club, Near Perumanoor Gate (Thevara), Cochin Shipyard Limited, Kochi – 682 015.

faq.question: Q3. How many General Worker (Canteen) vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 06 UR, 03 OBC, 02 SC, 01 ST and 01 EWS. CSL may increase or decrease the number.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CSL General Worker (Canteen)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a pass in VII Std. A catering certificate course, knowledge of Malayalam and experience in preparing or serving meals are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit shall not exceed 30 years as on 24 November 2026, so applicants should be born on or after 25 November 1996. It is relaxable by 3 years for OBC (Non Creamy Layer) and 5 years for SC/ST in posts reserved for them.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a CSL General Worker (Canteen)?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated pay in the first year of contract is ₹20,200, with an annual increase in later years and extra pay for extra hours of work.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring Annexure I with a recent passport size photograph, an original photo-identity proof, Aadhaar (original and self-attested copy), and original certificates with self-attested copies for age, qualification and caste.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Practical Test out of 100 marks, after certificate verification at the walk-in. Pass marks are 50% for unreserved and EWS, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST, for their reserved vacancies only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSL General Worker (Canteen) job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis for five years, depending on organizational requirement and individual performance. CSL is not liable to offer appointment during or after the contract period.

faq.question: Q10. Can women apply?
faq.answer: The notice says only male candidates need to apply, as the work involves multiple shifts including night hours beyond 7 pm.
